scope: Source-owner-approved reusable facts only; no original incident, packet, identifier, timing, digest, source, model answer, provenance package or machine path is published.

facts.lesson: An internal diagnostics structure is not a serialized wire contract.
facts.application: Check actual serialization and the receiver before claiming that a diagnostic field is available on the wire.

facts.lesson: Default DTO fields on an early return are not measured state.
facts.application: Follow assignment and return paths. An unassigned false or empty value does not prove that the corresponding observation took place.

facts.lesson: Mailbox lifetime follows actual object construction and destruction scope.
facts.application: Read the ownership and construction path instead of inferring a per-connection reset from the connection name.

facts.lesson: A generic error does not prove successful submission or an observed owner.
facts.application: Enumerate aggregate early-return paths. Elapsed time cannot select a failing branch or establish that execution began.

limits: These are bounded source-review rules, not an original cause, a fix, loaded-binary provenance, native-tool completion, or permission to query, reset, replay, build, deploy or run a business action.
